path-navigation.title: Path Navigation
path-navigation.description: Path navigation game! Drag the character along the specified path. Practice path planning and logical thinking. Choose the correct direction to reach the destination.

counting-classification.title: Counting & Classification
counting-classification.description: Count and classify items! Practice counting, categorizing, and grouping items based on specified criteria. Ideal for developing foundational math skills.

conditional-matching.title: Conditional Matching
conditional-matching.description: Conditional matching! Select items that match the specified conditions. Practice conditional thinking (if-then) and comparison. Develop understanding of logic.

sequencing.title: Sequencing
sequencing.description: Sequencing steps! Arrange instructions or events correctly in order. Practice algorithmic thinking and systematic planning.

step-counting.title: Step Counting
step-counting.description: Step counting! Calculate the number of steps required to reach the destination. Practice counting, measuring distance, and estimating.

fruit-matching-grid.title: Fruit Matching Grid
fruit-matching-grid.description: Fruit matching! Find identical fruits in the square grid. Practice pattern recognition, memory, and observation. Develop focus and attention to detail.

grid-based-coloring.title: Grid-based Coloring
grid-based-coloring.description: Grid coloring! Color the cells in the grid according to the specified pattern. Practice reading coordinates, understanding grid positions, and creativity.
